updates.text: Apex Tech Solutions reduced its account subscription, dropping its monthly software spend to $35,000.

policies.text: An account qualifies for priority support routing if it holds premier enterprise account status.
An account is granted access to Platinum Partner program benefits if it fulfills Platinum Partner status requirements.
A business qualifies for tax-exempt wholesale purchasing if it holds an active state commercial merchant license.
An account fulfills Platinum Partner status requirements if it meets enterprise security compliance criteria and provides executive board authorization.
An account meets enterprise security compliance criteria if it qualifies for priority support routing and maintains at least two certified security officers.
An account holds premier enterprise account status if its monthly software spend is at least $50,000 and its active contract length exceeds 12 months.
